summary: The Village Integrated Eye Workers Trial II (VIEW II) is a cluster-randomized trial in Nepal that evaluates the effectiveness of a community-based eye disease screening intervention using optical coherence tomography (OCT) and intraocular pressure (IOP) assessment to detect glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and age-related macular degeneration. The intervention aims to reduce vision impairment by identifying and referring cases to local eye hospitals for confirmatory diagnosis and follow-up management. A door-to-door census is conducted four years after the screening intervention to assess its impact, and ophthalmologic examinations are performed on eyes with incident visual impairment. This study provides strong evidence to guide national eye health programs and informs decisions on implementing eye disease screening in resource-limited settings.
